advice: VDRL titre at 3, 6, 12 months. Test for HIV, HBsAg. Partner notification and treatment. Avoid sexual contact until treatment of both partners complete. Fever, chills and body ache within 24 hours of the injection may occur (Jarisch–Herxheimer reaction) — take paracetamol; this is not penicillin allergy.
name: Syphilis (early)

rx.sig: Deep IM single dose (1.2 MU each buttock) after test dose
